svg.title: Observer delivery and hidden singleton state
svg.desc: A registered local handler can update an ALV, while an external process needs transactional publication and durable processing evidence. Session-shared mutable state is a separate source of repeated-test failures.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(95%,96%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: An event callback is not a durable delivery record
Two notification paths, then a separate lifetime problem hidden in a singleton

g.text: Failure recovery needs persisted correlation and a delivery owner.
Singleton trap: test A caches approver A; test B reuses A unexpectedly.
Pass request context explicitly; a session singleton is not landscape-wide state.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,94%,88%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: A local event does not gain durability from its name. A durable consumer must tolerate duplicate or
stale events according to the actual delivery contract.
